payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully

condition.question: Is her jacket fully closed?
condition.criteria: Assess the same jacket's front closure in SOURCE and EDITED, distinguishing visible evidence of progress from evidence of the complete endpoint. Full achievement requires the front panels to meet along the closure with no visible opening. Concrete, reliably visible movement of the panels toward one another may establish partial fulfillment even if the entire closure cannot be seen. Do not infer progress from a change in pose or jacket motion alone. If neither progress nor completion can be judged from visible evidence, fulfillment is unobservable and must remain unresolved, not be scored as zero.
condition.binding: Compare the woman's jacket in SOURCE with that same jacket in EDITED. Assess the same front-closure region where it is visible, accounting for pose, occlusion, and visibility. Judge concrete visible movement of the panels toward one another as partial closure, and a visibly joined closure with no opening as complete. Assign no progress only when the same region is reliably comparable and shows no movement toward closure or is more open. Do not treat turning, swinging, or flaring of the jacket by itself as evidence that the panels moved together. If neither progress nor completion can be judged from visible evidence, preserve uncertainty rather than assigning zero or inferring progress.
condition.endpoint: Her jacket is fully closed, with no visible opening along the closure.
condition.necessity: This is the requested change and its complete endpoint.
condition.zero_when: The same closure region is reliably visible and comparable in SOURCE and EDITED, and shows no movement of the front panels toward one another or shows that the jacket is more open. Pose change or jacket motion alone is not evidence of progress. If neither progress nor completion can be judged because the relevant evidence is obscured, leave fulfillment unresolved.
condition.half_when: Visible, reliable evidence shows the front panels moving partway toward one another, but a visible opening remains; score the concrete incomplete closure as partial fulfillment. Do not infer this from pose change or jacket motion alone. If neither progress nor completion can be judged, preserve uncertainty as an unknown interval rather than assigning a score.
condition.full_when: The front panels visibly meet along the jacket closure with no visible opening remaining, as established from the visible closure region despite any pose change.
